'''Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited (GACL)''' is an Indian [[chemical substance]] manufacturing company, promoted by the [[Government of Gujarat]]. Its manufacturing facilities are located at [[Dahej]] and [[Vadodara]] in [[Gujarat]].<ref>{{Cite web|author=Ankur Jain|date=Sep 29, 2012|title=IICT: GACL to set up caustic soda plant with Nalco - Times of India|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/gacl-to-set-up-caustic-soda-plant-with-nalco/articleshow/16604080.cms|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210422163512/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/gacl-to-set-up-caustic-soda-plant-with-nalco/articleshow/16604080.cms|archive-date=2021-04-22|access-date=2021-04-22|website=The Times of India|language=en}}</ref> The company manufactures chemicals such as [[Sodium hydroxide|caustic soda]], [[sodium cyanide]], [[chloromethane]]s, [[sodium ferrocyanide]], [[Potassium hydroxide|caustic potash]], [[potassium carbonate]], [[hydrochloric acid]], [[phosphoric acid]] (85%) and [[hydrogen peroxide]].<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" />

== History ==
GACL was incorporated by Gujarat Industrial Investment Corporation (GIIC) on 29 March 1973. The [[Government of Gujarat]] is the owner and major promoter of GACL.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|title=Guj. Alkalies & Chem: Reports, Company History, Directors Report, Chairman's Speech, Auditors Report of Guj. Alkalies & Chem - NDTV|url=https://www.ndtv.com/business/stock/gujarat-alkalies-chemicals-ltd_gujalkali/reports|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210421133534/https://www.ndtv.com/business/stock/gujarat-alkalies-chemicals-ltd_gujalkali/reports|archive-date=2021-04-21|access-date=2021-04-21|website=www.ndtv.com|language=en}}</ref> The production began in 1976 at the Vadodara plant with a capacity of 37,425 MTPA of caustic soda.<ref name=":2">{{Cite news|title=Gujarat Alkalies & Chemicals Ltd.|work=Business Standard India|url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/gujarat-alkalies-217/information/company-history|access-date=2021-04-21|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210421133543/https://www.business-standard.com/company/gujarat-alkalies-217/information/company-history|archive-date=2021-04-21}}</ref> The company, along with other corporations like [[Gujarat State Fertilizers and Chemicals|GSFC]], Petrofils Co-operative Ltd., and Gujarat Electricity Board, promoted [[GIPCL Vadodara Gas based Power Station]] to fulfill electricity demand.<ref>{{Cite news|last=Market|first=Capital|date=2020-12-09|title=GIPCL jumps on securing land in Gujarat|work=Business Standard India|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/gipcl-jumps-on-securing-land-in-gujarat-120120900215_1.html|access-date=2021-03-02|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210302063945/https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/gipcl-jumps-on-securing-land-in-gujarat-120120900215_1.html|archive-date=2021-03-02}}</ref> After subsequent expansion at both the Vadodara and Dahej plant the total caustic soda productions reach 4,29,050 MTPA.<ref name=":2" />

== GNAL ==
GACL and [[National Aluminium Company]] (NALCO) will jointly expand the GACL's plant at Dahej. The joint venture plant, named GNAL, will have a capacity of 266,667 MTPA caustic soda plant along with a 130 MW [[Captive power plant|CPP]] at Dahej.<ref>{{Cite news|last=Market|first=Capital|date=2020-08-12|title=Board of Gujarat Alkalies & Chemicals approves revision in project costs|work=Business Standard India|url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/board-of-gujarat-alkalies-chemicals-approves-revision-in-project-costs-120081200302_1.html|access-date=2021-04-21|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210421153007/https://www.business-standard.com/article/news-cm/board-of-gujarat-alkalies-chemicals-approves-revision-in-project-costs-120081200302_1.html|archive-date=2021-04-21}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|agency=Press Trust of India|title=Gujarat Alkalies to set up ₹1,936-crore caustic soda plant|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/gujarat-alkalies-to-set-up-1936crore-caustic-soda-plant/article9335038.ece|access-date=2021-04-22|website=@businessline|date=11 November 2016 |language=en}}</ref> The equity holding of GACL and NALCO for the GNAL is in the ratio of 60:40.<ref>{{Cite web|title=GACL-NALCO Alkalies & Chemicals Pvt. Ltd.|url=http://www.gnal.co.in/|access-date=2021-04-22|website=www.gnal.co.in}}</ref> NALCO will purchase a minimum of 50,000 MTPA caustic soda from GNAL for its aluminium refineries.<ref>{{Cite news|last=Mazumdar|first=Rakhi|title=NALCO, GACL form JV to set up caustic soda plant|work=The Economic Times|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/indl-goods/svs/chem-/-fertilisers/nalco-gacl-form-jv-to-set-up-caustic-soda-plant/articleshow/50094132.cms|access-date=2021-04-22|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210422144351/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/indl-goods/svs/chem-/-fertilisers/nalco-gacl-form-jv-to-set-up-caustic-soda-plant/articleshow/50094132.cms|archive-date=2021-04-22}}</ref>
